sentences.text: The postmortem says the skipped weekend restart remains in place but must be accompanied by monitoring that covers long running processes.
The slow shrinking of the connection pool went unnoticed for six days because the dashboard showing pool usage was not connected to an alert.
Action item AI-1 calls for a regression test that runs the connection pool for the equivalent of seven days.
The load test environment restarts the service between test runs and therefore never reproduces a multi day runtime, which is why testing over longer periods is needed.
